question: Where can I get the list of grid connection requests in the United States, with project, technology, capacity (MW), connection node, status and date?

answer.summary: There is no single official national list: each ISO/RTO publishes its own. MISO (JSON), CAISO and NYISO (Excel) were downloaded and give technology, MW, POI, status and dates; only NYISO names developers. PJM has a web viewer with export links not tested; SPP, ISO-NE, ERCOT not retrieved. Berkeley Lab's Queued Up compilation (7 ISOs plus ~50 non-ISO areas) was blocked here.
main_caveats: Operator lists are regional and use different fields, MW bases and status codes; do not add them up as a national total.
A connection request does not prove permits, financing or construction.
MISO and CAISO omit developer names; NYISO status is a numeric code without legend.
Withdrawn and done requests sit in the same files as active ones; filter by status before counting.
The MISO JSON endpoint is undocumented and no licence was found for any operator file.
answer.confidence_reason: Three operators in different regions were downloaded and inspected; PJM, SPP, ISO-NE, ERCOT, non-ISO utilities and the compilation were not read.

sources.name: MISO generator interconnection queue (JSON endpoint behind the Project Status tool)
sources.adds: Only source tested that returns the whole queue of one RTO as structured records without an account, including withdrawn and done requests, POI name and MW.
sources.summary: Full MISO queue as JSON: 4,101 requests with status, fuel, MW, POI, TO, state and dates; no developer names.
sources.coverage_note: MISO footprint only (one of seven ISO/RTOs); not a national list.

coverage.geographic: MISO footprint: Midwest and South (MI, IL, IN, AR, LA, MN, WI, IA, MS, MO, TX, ND, KY and others).

unit.value: MW (field names summerNetMW, winterNetMW, dp1/dp2ErisMw/NrisMw); unit and basis are not documented, inferred from field names.

attempts.note: Landing page read on 2026-11-19: lists maps, dashboards and a status filter tool; no field list or unit.

inclusion_rule.value: Observed: 4,101 records with applicationStatus Withdrawn, Active, Done, Pending Revision Approval, Pending Transfer and LEGACY: Done; queueDate from 2015-04-15 to 2026-11-03. No inclusion rule published.

attempts.note: No status definitions or inclusion rule on the landing page.

reference_date.value: Live endpoint. Response headers on 2026-11-19: x-pci-data-fetched-at 15:20:50Z, fresh-until 15:25:50Z.

update_frequency.value: Not stated by MISO. Observed cache headers imply the backend is refreshed about every 5 minutes (data fetched-at to fresh-until); this is not a statement about when MISO changes records.

exclusions.value: No developer or project name fields are exposed; 507 of 4,101 records have an empty state and 545 an empty fuelType.

key_fields.field: projectNumber
key_fields.meaning: MISO request ID (J = generator, R and S older series); the only identity published.

key_fields.field: applicationStatus
key_fields.meaning: Active, Withdrawn, Done, Pending Revision Approval, Pending Transfer, LEGACY: Done (undefined on the site).

key_fields.field: queueDate / withdrawnDate / doneDate / inService / negInService / giaToExec
key_fields.meaning: ISO 8601 timestamps; queue entry, withdrawal, completion, requested in-service and GIA execution dates.

key_fields.field: fuelType / facilityType / svcType
key_fields.meaning: Technology (Solar, Battery Storage, Wind, Hybrid, Gas...) and service type ERIS/NRIS.

key_fields.field: summerNetMW / winterNetMW / dp1ErisMw / dp1NrisMw / dp2ErisMw / dp2NrisMw
key_fields.meaning: Requested MW and the MW assigned in decision-point phases 1 and 2.

key_fields.field: poiName / transmissionOwner / state / county
key_fields.meaning: Point of interconnection name (non-empty in 3,746 of 4,101), TO, state and county.

key_fields.field: studyCycle / studyGroup / studyPhase / postGIAStatus / sisPhase1
key_fields.meaning: Study cohort (DPP-2022...), region group and phase; post-GIA status such as Under Construction or In Service.

steps: GET the endpoint (HEAD returns 405; use GET). The body is a single JSON array of 4,101 objects (2,389,518 bytes on 2026-11-19).
Filter on applicationStatus (Active = 1,133; Withdrawn = 2,327; Done = 548) and on fuelType/state as needed.
Parse dates as UTC timestamps; withdrawnDate is present on 2,310 records, doneDate and negInService only on some.
Treat the endpoint as undocumented: it is not linked as a download on the landing page and may change without notice.
reading_traps: No developer or project name: the identity is only projectNumber, so linking to other sources needs POI, county, MW and dates.
Empty strings are used for unknown values: poiName empty on about 355 records, state empty on 507, fuelType empty on 545 (many are recent ERAS or DPP-2026 entries).
summerNetMW can be 0.0 for requests still being revised (e.g. J4182 ERAS Study Cycle 2) even though the request is Active.
Withdrawn records keep their MW and POI, so summing MW without filtering status counts withdrawn requests.
Done and LEGACY: Done are not defined; do not read them as in service. postGIAStatus gives In Service (88) and Under Construction (128).

problems: Endpoint is not documented on the landing page; found by testing the Project Status tool's data path. HEAD returns 405 while GET returns 200.
No licence or terms of use found for the data.

evidence.claim: Landing page lists queue maps, dashboards and the Project Status Tool; no downloads or API are listed.
evidence.quote: Filter projects in the queue by status, fuel type, and/or state.

evidence.claim: Observed on 2026-11-19: GET returned 4,101 records; 1,133 Active, 2,327 Withdrawn, 548 Done; queueDate 2015-04-15 to 2026-11-03.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL 'https://www.caiso.com/documents/cluster-16-queue-report.xlsx' -o c16.xlsx  # sheet 'Cluster 16 Queue Report', header in row 1
how_to_use.example_result: 55357 | Airchair 1 | Photovoltaic/Solar 250 MW + Storage/Battery 250 MW | NET MW POI 250 | Kern, CA | PG&E FRESNO | PTO PGAE | POI GATES-MIDWAY 500kV | Requested COD 48335 (2032-05-01) | Queue Date 46296 (2026-10-01) | Application Date 46303.49 | Energy Only Requested
steps: Open https://www.caiso.com/planning/Pages/GeneratorInterconnection/Default.aspx and take the current cluster workbook link (Cluster 16 posted 2026-10-16).
Read the first sheet; Cluster 15 has a sheet for active requests and one named 'Withdrawn'.
Convert Excel serial dates (days since 1899-12-30) to ISO dates; drop fully empty rows.
For Cluster 14 and earlier use the Reporting tab of RIMS (https://rimspub.caiso.com/rimsui/logon.do, landing page returned 200 but contents not tested).
reading_traps: Cluster 15 'Cluster 15 ' sheet has 190 rows of which 104 are completely empty (86 real requests); the Withdrawn sheet has 99 rows with 15 empty (84 requests). Header cell names carry trailing spaces.
Cluster 16 holds 226 requests, all with Queue Date 2026-10-01 (queue window) and distinct application dates 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-15; the date is the cluster window, not a processing position.
NET MW 1 and NET MW 2 are per-fuel nameplate while NET MW POI is the capped POI value, so hybrids do not sum to POI MW.
The Cluster 16 header cell begins with the marking 'CAISO PUBLIC' followed by a newline.
Only the latest two clusters were downloaded; the files are not a cumulative queue.

problems: Each cluster is a separate file; no cumulative queue file was found in the page text.
No licence or terms found for the files.

steps: Open https://www.nyiso.com/interconnections and copy the current 'Interconnection Queue' link (the file name changes monthly and carries a ?t= parameter).
Use sheet 'Interconnection Queue' for active generation (107 requests), ' Cluster Projects' (note the leading space; 146), 'Withdrawn' (2,518) and 'In Service' (about 158).
Convert date cells (Excel serials) to ISO dates; proposed dates may be text such as 04-2028.
Read cells by column letter: empty cells are omitted by some parsers, shifting columns on sparse rows.
reading_traps: Sheets use different headers (Withdrawn: 'Owner/Developer', 'Z', 'S'; Cluster: 'Interconnection Customer Name'); do not stack them without mapping.
Some Date of IR values are placeholders (minimum parsed 1900-01-02) and some Last Updated Date values lie after the file date (up to 2026-11-30 parsed); treat as data-entry quality issues.
The link carries a time parameter (?t=); fetch the page again for the current file.
Load projects share the workbook but are not generation requests.
Project Status # is a bare number without legend in the file.

problems: Status codes are not defined in the workbook or on the page read.

evidence.claim: Page links the queue workbook and notes the account/CEII requirement for the projects portal.
